families.provisionalModel: Template Builder is an extractable browser sandbox around public vNext Core contracts. Its browser-local runtime turns canonical package snapshots and accepted change packets into a normalized render/store model, then supports bounded structural editing, WYSIWYG drafts, rich-inline commit and replay, and virtualized viewport rendering. Canonical package changes continue through vNext-native mutation and transaction bridges; browser-local drafts, DOM state, caches, and layout summaries are not canonical truth.

subgroups.title: Sandbox Runtime, Mutation Packets, and Store-backed Render Model
subgroups.responsibility: Define the extractable sandbox boundary and turn accepted Core mutations into browser cache, store, and render-model state, including bounded plain-text history and live-layout summaries.
subgroups.boundary: Owns sandbox/package separation, snapshot-to-runtime normalization, mutation/change packets, cache/store application, plain-text actions/history, and store-backed render facts. It does not own structural packet semantics, viewport windowing, active WYSIWYG input, rich-inline commits, durable persistence, or renderer output.
evidenceChecks: Verify public-package-only imports and no root runtime dependency in examples/template-builder-sandbox/package.json, source imports, and sandbox boundary tests.
Verify packet, cache, store, and snapshot-staleness ownership in examples/template-builder-sandbox/src/coreBoundary.ts, browser runtime modules, and tests/templateBuilderSandboxBoundary.test.ts.
Verify plain-text history and live-layout summaries against vNext authoring and live-layout helpers rather than historical phase narratives.

subgroups.title: Viewport, Scheduler, and Virtualized Rendering
subgroups.responsibility: Convert bounded render-model facts and browser measurements into visible ranges, render windows, scheduler decisions, virtual stacks, lazy-detail plans, and resilient viewport/node anchors.
subgroups.boundary: Owns viewport prediction and rendering-window behavior after a store-backed model exists. It does not own the underlying runtime store, structural mutation packet apply, DOM recycling or performance timing claims, contenteditable caret mapping, or production renderer output.
evidenceChecks: Reproduce the shape assertions in tests/templateBuilderSandboxBoundary.test.ts: 72 sections, 936 nodes, bounded visible/rendered sets, spacer preservation, and far-node anchor restore.
Inspect scheduler sequence, request-id, and stale-candidate guards and preserve the audit as shape evidence rather than a wall-clock performance claim.

subgroups.title: Structural Runtime, Commands, and Navigation
subgroups.responsibility: Define the structural projection and packet-v1 path from accepted Core structural operations through sandbox bridge/store application, inspector commands, outline jumps, and diagnostics navigation.
subgroups.boundary: Owns structural-tree semantics and packet-v1 application constraints. It does not make packet v1 a durable or public API, own generic runtime-cache rules, implement persistence or collaboration, or claim production editor integration.
evidenceChecks: Check that projection remains read-only over canonical facts; structural packet v1 only updates lookup indexes and leaves the boot snapshot stale; and bridge routes use accepted Core operations.
Verify navigation rejects diagnostics without a nodeId using examples/template-builder-sandbox/src/coreBoundary.ts, mutation bridge modules, and tests/templateBuilderSandboxBoundary.test.ts.

subgroups.title: WYSIWYG Draft Input, Selection, and Browser Guards
subgroups.responsibility: Define safe browser-local WYSIWYG draft activation, selection/caret/text-command/IME handling, pre-commit layout summaries, and planning-only toolbar, field, and history affordances.
subgroups.boundary: Owns local active-draft behavior and guard outcomes before rich-inline execution. It does not own canonical rich-inline mutation, contenteditable segment capture or range mapping, durable history or persistence, actual renderer/layout output, or a production primary-input replacement.
evidenceChecks: Check design-lock truth layers and safe eligibility against active browser modules and focused tests; draft state must remain browser-local and commit only through the bridge.
Verify IME composition blocks command, range, and commit actions; verify the Phase 81-84 summaries are planning states rather than production rich-text behavior.

subgroups.title: Rich Inline Capture, Commit, Replay, and Session Lifecycle
subgroups.responsibility: Carry rich-inline facts from contenteditable-like segment/range capture and local style/chip state through commit planning, vNext-native commit, undo/redo replay, session-record preparation, and live/exact stale signaling.
subgroups.boundary: Owns rich-inline lifecycle contracts and their explicit deferred states. It does not claim renderer artifact generation, storage-adapter writes, collaboration merge, WASM measurement replacement, or that the hardened contenteditable surface is the primary editor input.
evidenceChecks: Verify FlowDoc UTF-16 offsets rather than raw shaping-byte offsets; prove local segment, range, and hardening layers do not mutate packages.
Inspect src/authoring/richInlineCommit.ts and bridge tests for accepted-plan-only mutation, stale-plan rejection, field/style preservation, and replay.
Verify session records are JSON-safe preparation only, exclude layout/artifact truth, and treat Phase 130 stale signaling as invalidation rather than rendering.

conflicts.summary: Earlier range and execution cards describe future work while later cards describe bounded implementation; neither chronology nor PASS language establishes production readiness.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Inspect current browser modules and focused sandbox/rich-inline tests; distinguish bounded implementation, primary-input status, and production readiness.

conflicts.summary: The active sandbox draft remains textarea-first even though a contenteditable hardening boundary exists.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Inspect public/app.js, draftContenteditableSurfaceHardening.js, event wiring, and browser tests for the active input path.

conflicts.summary: The session record is storage-ready but the boundary expressly excludes storage-adapter writes.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Inspect src/authoring/richInlineSessionPersistence.ts, exports, callers, and tests for record construction versus adapter writes.

conflicts.summary: Live/exact parity proves stale invalidation, not exact renderer or export parity.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Inspect src/authoring/richInlineCommit.ts, mutation bridge/core boundary, and tests/richInlineLiveExactParityAudit.test.ts for invalidation-only behavior.

conflicts.summary: Structural packet v1 is reliable enough as a sandbox foundation transport while remaining non-durable and non-public.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Verify structural packet consumers, routes, and focused tests; retain the sandbox-foundation boundary unless executable integration evidence proves more.

conflicts.summary: The viewport audit proves bounded composition with synthetic shape assertions, not browser timing, recycled-DOM pools, or production performance.
conflicts.evidenceNeeds: Re-run or inspect focused shape tests and require separate performance evidence for any latency claim.
